_howToEdit: This file holds all the real game content. Edit the text, save, and push. No code changes needed.
Each category has exactly 5 tiles, in row order from top (row 1) to bottom (row 5).
"name" is the title shown on the board and the How to Play page; "short" is the label on the small example board. Aaja Nachle's "prompt" is the line shown before the song plays.
Image and MP3 file names refer to files in the assets folder, for example "fetch-1.jpg" means assets/fetch-1.jpg.

Fetch: "caption" is optional text shown under the picture. Hook Step: the song loops between "start" and "end" (minutes:seconds) until Stop is pressed; leave both as "" to loop the whole song. "answer" is optional; if filled in, a Reveal Answer button shows it.
Character: exactly 5 clues, from hardest to easiest. "image" is optional (leave it as "" for none).
Demo tiles on the How to Play page live in demo.json, not here.

Timers: characterSecondsPerClue is how long each Main Kaun? clue stays (first clue, then each later one). wordSeconds and movieSeconds are how long a Judwaa or Picture Abhi Baaki Hai tile stays open before the answer shows. answerSeconds is the Buzzed answer timer.
A "prompt" can be one line or a list of lines; the first line is the headline. Aaja Nachle also adds the clip length automatically.

Jagga Jasoos: each tile's "where" fills {where} in the prompt ("the office" or "91springboard"). Every tile opens with an "Are you ready? 3, 2, 1, GO!" countdown; set "fetchCountdown": false to turn it off.
title: Game Board

tiles.plot: A reserved office clerk, whose marriage is devoid of affection, assumes a flamboyant disguise to participate in a dance competition alongside his unsuspecting wife. While she becomes captivated by his boisterous alter ego, she remains oblivious to the fact that the two men competing for her affection are, in reality, one and the same person. His elaborate deception soon forces him to confront whether love can flourish without being recognised for who he truly is.

A prominent industrialist’s insistence on familial tradition leads him to sever ties with his eldest son, whose choice of life partner defies the household’s expectations. The ensuing estrangement spans continents, leaving the younger heir to devise an elaborate reconciliation without revealing his true intentions. As the family’s younger generation grows up amid unresolved grievances, a carefully orchestrated reunion forces the patriarch to confront the consequences of his own inflexibility.

A landlord who runs a failing garage perpetually struggles to collect rent from his two financially inept tenants: one drifts between short-lived jobs, while the other has come to the city chasing his late father’s bank job. Their fortunes appear to change when a crossed telephone line connects them to a kidnapping negotiation involving a wealthy industrialist’s abducted granddaughter. Instead of alerting the authorities, the trio decide to impersonate the kidnappers and demand a share of the ransom. Their scheme spirals into chaos when the original abductors grow suspicious, a ransom exchange becomes increasingly complicated, and an innocent family’s desperation collides with the trio’s greed and incompetence.

A notorious con artist poses as a film director to persuade an unsuspecting village to participate in an elaborate cinematic deception. His actual objective, however, is to rob a heavily guarded consignment of priceless antiques aboard a moving train. With his ambitious actress girlfriend, a gullible village, and an Oscar-obsessed superstar unknowingly caught in his scheme, he orchestrates an audacious spectacle in which fiction becomes the perfect disguise for a criminal enterprise.

A perpetually unemployed young man establishes an unconventional organisation dedicated to facilitating romantic unions, despite being spectacularly inept at resolving the complications of his own heart. His life takes an unexpected turn when he becomes enamoured with a young woman whose affections are irrevocably directed towards her college sweetheart. Suppressing his own romantic inclinations, he undertakes the rather ill-advised mission of reuniting the two, only to become entangled in a labyrinth of mistaken identities, an influential politician father’s opposition, and a kidnapping by a local gangster. As his self-appointed role as a benevolent matchmaker spirals into absurdity, he must confront the possibility that facilitating another man’s happiness may come at the expense of his own.

prompt: Every team, send up one player who hasn't come up yet in this game.
You'll be judged on how well you dance, how quickly you pick up the step, and whether you keep dancing for the entire clip.
